text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing by the central 
plaza—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Don't be shy, please! If you come 
out, I'll give you a big tight hug, you 
know~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just one bite and you'll get instant 
supreme fortune— I'll give you some 
fortune-bringing dried sardines~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, we really cannot seem to find it, can 
we~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day to you~. Um~ have you perhaps 
seen a calico cat with a red collar?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~. Actually, a local resident 
from the neighborhood came to visit us 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It seems the pet cat they keep has 
wandered into the academy grounds.
choice_data_list: I'll help look for it too.
I'll help look for it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, are you sure? I am ever so grateful 
for your kindness~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, everyone split up to search for 
the cat, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Meat is justice! The barbecue is freshly 
grilled~! Hungry kitty, come on over!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Funnyaka~... Hannyaka~... Puni-puni~, nya 
nya nyaaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It has appeared! "The lost cat lies in the 
eastern direction"! Time to mobilize~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While each searched for the cat in their 
own unique way, I returned to the central 
plaza—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello again~. How are you faring~?
choice_data_list: Wait, you haven't moved a single step...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was putting myself in the kitty's shoes 
to think about where a kitty might like to 
go~♪
choice_data_list: Maybe it's somewhere it feels safe...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Indeed, this is an unfamiliar 
place for the kitty, so it must be feeling 
very anxious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let us search for a place 
where the kitty might feel safe~. That is 
one step forward, is it not~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
............ But where on earth might a 
kitty feel safe, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so Mejiro Bright began pondering all 
over again. While looking around for the 
cat, I decided to periodically return and 
check in on her thoughts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, perhaps the kitty is having a 
thrilling, wonderful adventure right about 
now~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The academy has so many different 
facilities, so to a kitty, I suppose it 
might feel just like an amusement park~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If it is an amusement park, then... Oh, a 
wonderful thought just came to me♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, let us begin by recalling how I 
felt when I visited Father's amusement 
park for the first time~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so Mejiro Bright was lost in thought 
once more. Deciding to continue the search 
for the cat, I figured I would come check 
back on her ideas now and then...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's strange, isn't it... Not to be 
tempted even by the scent of such juicy 
meat...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To think even my cat-finding specialty, 
the "Paw-Squishing Divination", couldn't 
locate it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The sun is starting to set, so should we 
head back to the central plaza for now?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who's over there! He~y, Bright, 
howdy~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki-san, shh! Keep it down...! Look at 
Bright-san's feet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, wherever could that kitty be, I 
wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaa~ purrrr.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, a calico cat with a red 
collar was lying down comfortably right at 
Mejiro Bright's feet...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it! That's the cat we've 
been looking for! Bright-san hasn't 
noticed it at all...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So we don't alert the kitty, let's tell 
Bright with body language~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, over there, it is Fukukitaru-sama 
and Taiki-sama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They are waving their hands. Fufufu, good 
day to you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Is it just my imagination, or are they 
greeting me with far more passion than 
usual...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...? Are those... gestures? Look... 
downward, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Unyaan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness~. If it isn't a kitty♪ How 
are you feeling today~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you are a calico kitty, aren't 
you? That red collar looks so very lovely 
on you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? A calico kitty... with a red 
collar... Somehow, that sounds rather 
familiar~...

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: (rises up)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
............ Oh, I remember now. I was 
searching for this little one~.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: (trot, trot, trot—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us quickly catch the kitty, shall we~? 
Up, we go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my...? The kitty is no longer here~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright-sa~n! It already ran off ages ago!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's go chase after that kitty~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, everyone chased after the cat 
frantically, and somehow managed to catch 
it.
